'''Zalli''' was a [[Zelosian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]-affiliated [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Zalli developed technology to aid her when pursuing her quarry and she tested a new weapon that she had invested every time she went on a hunt, because she was superstitious about using the same device twice in a row.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
